sources.notes: Brand IG is small; no 3x outliers. Tagged page needs login (not accessed).
Top video 4K (4.8x); too small to include.
HeightGPT / Hite UGC creator (#heightgptapp, bio link heightgpt.app). Added by hand 2026-11-25; the daily scout only scans TikTok.

patterns: GoTall grows on TikTok, not Instagram: its IG has 6K followers and no outliers, while small UGC accounts named <name>.gotall hit 200K to 2M views.
Top format: text-on-screen over a deadpan face-cam (no talking), 7 to 14 seconds. 7 of 16 outliers.
Second: face-cam hook then a cut to the app prediction screen (app-screen-recording), 8 to 25 seconds. 4 of 16.
Third: talking face-cam on a body or height myth (wrist bump, worst heights), 40 to 76 seconds. 3 of 16. Series challenges (day X of 50) work on the brand account.
Hooks name a specific age + height or force a choice (would you rather), so viewers comment their own numbers. Comment counts on winners: 470 to 7.6K.
Winners get re-filmed: the same hook in a new location hit outlier level again (torso question twice, wrist bump twice, age chart twice).
Audio is almost always a quiet 'original sound' loop or the creator's own voice, not a big trending song.
CTA is soft: caption tag of the app; the strongest show the app result as the payoff at the end.
Engine (per a public write-up of GoTall's founder): 10 TikToks a day to find a format, then DM about 50 creators a day to copy it, then paid ads behind organic winners.

HeightGPT (Hite) UGC on Instagram: a 445-follower account gets 130K to 1.1M views with 6 to 7 sec deadpan selfie cams under an 'Avg Height by age' list, then a 1 sec flash of the app's prediction screen. 7 of its 9 outliers are that exact format, re-filmed in new outfits and rooms.

reference_bledarrrrg.app_promoted: GoTall (competitor; 87 of 96 recent captions tag @GoTall). Reference only, not a GoPeak creator.
reference_bledarrrrg.notes: Posts daily-ish, almost all text-on-screen face-cam under 15 sec. 4 outliers (880K, 776K, 527K, 200K) vs a 4K median; best hooks are a would-you-rather on torso length and an 'if you are X at 14 you WILL be Y at 18' table. Reuses winning hooks in new locations.
